align: Match the selected source objects to the last selected target.
Uses translation, rotation, and scale. A selected time range aligns every frame in that range.
translation: Match only world-space translation to the last selected target.
translation_all: Match translation on every keyed frame of the selected source objects.
rotation: Match only world-space rotation to the last selected target.
rotation_all: Match rotation on every keyed frame of the selected source objects.
scale: Match only world-space scale to the last selected target.
scale_all: Match scale on every keyed frame of the selected source objects.
